entities.name: Zoltan Sarosy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zoltan Sarosy was a Hungarian-Canadian professional chess master and supercentenarian. He was born in Budapest and won numerous tournaments in his native country before immigrating to Canada in the early 1950s.
